title: Saving an audience segment gives no sign it worked: the name clears and the page refreshes in silence

source.ref: Toni House of Fates QA audit 2026-11-16 (project thread)

detail:
EVIDENCE: handleSaveSegment in components/spaces/email/audience-picker.tsx called createSpaceSegment, then cleared the name field and refreshed. Nothing on screen said the segment was saved or where it went, so an owner could save the same audience twice or think it failed. createSpaceSegment already returns the new segment's id.

CLOSED 2026-11-16: a successful save now shows "Saved. Find “<name>” under Send to, Saved segments." (role=status) and selects the new segment from the returned id, so the audience on screen is the one just saved. The line clears when the owner picks another audience or types a new name. components/spaces/email/audience-picker.test.tsx covers it. Probe scripts/probes/segment-saved-confirmation.mjs fails on the prior tree and passes here.
